steps.title: Mars Global Architecture
steps.text: Welcome. Use the keyboard arrows to navigate through the 100% Azure-centric architecture.

steps.title: 1. Frontend & Security Layer
steps.text: Node.js app on Azure Static Web Apps. Protected by WAF, Rate Limiting, and CORS. Dynamic multi-brand via URL.

steps.title: 2. Master Data Management (MDM)
steps.text: Azure Functions query CosmosDB. If user exists, pet array is updated; if not, a Global ID is created.

steps.title: 3. Orchestration & Decoupling
steps.text: Clean data flows to Azure Service Bus. This guarantees 0% data loss if Salesforce experiences downtime.

steps.title: 4. Integration Loop-back
steps.text: Sender Function asynchronously injects data into Salesforce, receives Contact ID, and updates CosmosDB.
